added_claim_errors: 「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてある」 assumes contents of this employer’s rules that the packet does not establish.
「あとから有給に戻すのが面倒になります」 asserts an administrative difficulty not established by the packet.
「LINEで残しておくと、『言った言わない』になりません」 overstates what keeping a written record guarantees.

reasons: Both immediately correct the premise and correctly give October 1, five days, and the 80% attendance condition. B narrowly wins because it consistently requests paid leave and states the limits on changing its date more precisely; A invites removal of the paid-leave request and adds unsupported assurances. A explicitly identifies proportional allocation, whereas B leaves that classification implicit despite correctly calculating 15 weekly hours. B is unnecessarily long for LINE and weakens an automatic conditional entitlement with 「付与されている可能性が高い」.
